text:
Zara (CS): quick alert — customers saw a spike of 429s from our embed generation endpoint during onboarding window this morning. impacted ~12 tenants; a few reported failed batches and slowed verification. tracked in incident doc: https://redwood.share/inc/1823456789 :warning:

OpsBot: INCIDENT-2026-3120 | Severity: P2 | Affected: ~12 onboarding tenants | Oncall paging eng

Ben (Onboard): breakdown: 8 are mid-onboard, 4 are enterprise trialing features. 3 enterprise accounts have migration dates in next 14 days — high priority.

Zara (CS): comms idea: short status email + prioritized 1:1s for the 3 high-priority tenants. offer expedited embed reprocessing and 5 days credits. Need legal ok and an RCA blurb from eng. Also want localized sends for APAC contacts.

Rita (Eng): root cause: autoscaler mis-scheduled a small subset of embed workers causing hot queues and rate-limit responses from the internal queuing layer. fixed at 07:18 UTC and reprocessed backlog. we'll supply a short transparent RCA paragraph.

Leah (Legal): credits and reprocessing fine. keep message factual and avoid language about SLA failure. I can review templates in 30 mins.

Noah (AM): please include me on the three enterprise threads. I'll handle account-level concessions if renewal risk appears.

Zara (CS): draft status (concise):

"Hi <Name>,

We experienced intermittent rate-limit responses affecting embed generation during part of this morning's onboarding runs. Our team resolved the issue and completed reprocessing of affected batches. We're sorry for the disruption. To help, we'd like to offer expedited reprocessing and 5 days of credits. If you'd like prioritized assistance, reply and we'll schedule a dedicated session.

— Zara, Customer Success"

Rita (Eng): RCA blurb for email: "Cause: an autoscaler scheduling bug created a small pool imbalance and transient queue hot spots, resulting in rate-limited requests to our internal embed worker layer. Fix: scaled and redistributed workers; backfill completed; Mitigation: improved autoscaler checks and added a targeted alert for queue skew."

Ben (Onboard): Can eng also provide a short troubleshooting checklist for calls? simple steps: inspect job status -> trigger reprocess -> verify item counts match expected.

Rita (Eng): added checklist to doc: `check-job-status -> trigger-reprocess -> confirm processed_count == expected_count`

Zara (CS): Action items:
- send status email to impacted tenants within 45 mins (owner: Zara)
- schedule 1:1 prioritized sessions for enterprise accounts (owner: Ben + Noah)
- legal review of copy (owner: Leah)
- eng to paste final RCA and checklist in doc (owner: Rita)
- ops to tag support tickets with incident-1823456789 (owner: OpsBot)

OpsBot: Support tickets created: 12. Label: incident-1823456789.

Noah (AM): If any enterprise account reports churn intent, offer an extra month credit and escalate to me.

Zara (CS): we'll capture a short post-call survey: "Was the reprocessing sufficient? (yes/no)" + "On a scale 1-5 how likely are you to continue at renewal?" Flag <=3 for AM follow-up.

Rita (Eng): I'll post a one-paragraph postmortem in 48 hours and set an alert to detect similar autoscaler skew.

Zara (CS): thanks everyone — I'll post the localized subject lines and start sending. will report back after first 6 outreach attempts. :white_check_mark:
